milestone: Conditional chain means, covariance identity and a bounded de Sitter forward check
sampling: Independent points uniform in physical volume, conditional on a fixed N; fixed coordinate diamond |eta|+norm(x)<1/2

importance.sampling: Flat iid point clouds; exact known density-ratio products over chains; time-reflection antithetic average; paired subtraction of flat counts; not actual curved causal-set draws
importance.primary: Analytic h^2 derivative from polynomial products, divided by 12 times exact flat chain probability
importance.intervals: Bonferroni Student-t intervals, alpha=0.01 over all 21 slope entries (3 derivative plus 18 finite-h). CLT approximation, not finite-sample coverage guarantee
importance.success: All 3 derivative intervals lie entirely within +/-5% of their conditional RSS slope; otherwise FORWARD_SLOPE_NOT_RESOLVED

quadrature.scope: Only C2; consecutive quadrature agreement is numerical evidence, not a certified error bound; report discrete tested h values, no interpolation claim

direct.mean_check: C2 mean vs independent quadrature: 99% familywise Bonferroni Student-t interval across 8 cells; stochastic diagnostic, not equivalence proof
direct.covariance: Sample covariance of Ck/choose(N,k) across independent orders; preserve all off-diagonal terms
direct.inverse: Exploratory linear inverse of F2/p2-1,F3/p3-1 to RT^2,R00T^2; report raw bias and single-order RMSE without clipping, fitting, or claimed coverage

gates.deterministic: Exact rational coefficients; exhaustive finite atomic covariance identity; brute-force weighted chain counts; flat and converged geometric quadrature
gates.no_retuning: No additional seeds, changed budgets or changed thresholds after the first target run; retain failed gates and label post-run fixes
gates.publication: Public source commit before first target execution; not an independent preregistration service

nonclaims: No correction of an error in the RSS paper
No novelty claim for conditioning or U-statistics
No resolution of unrestricted density twins
No generic separation of R and R00 validated by the one-parameter de Sitter family
No absolute curvature without an independent scale
No universal validity window for all observables or geometries
No changed interpretation of the previous negative benchmark
